meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 它会先查真实提示清单和你的 settings.json,再读对应实现代码,然后用你提问的语言给出这条 senpi 提示(含 TUI 的 Tip: 行)背后机制的深入说明,并注明所读文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或你能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 它会查清单并读代码后给出深入解释。

say.text: senpi 现在有哪些提示是我能看到的?
say.note: 它会读你的 settings.json 判断你能看到哪些。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条提示是怎么实现的?
say.note: 它会给出去重与 architect 管线的逐文件说明。

howto.what_en: It checks the real tip list and your settings.json, reads the matching source code, then explains in your language the mechanism behind a senpi tip (including TUI Tip: lines), citing file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a senpi tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It queries the list and reads the code, then explains.

say_en.text: Which senpi tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json to gate the list.

say_en.text: How does the post-Fable-5-refusal tip work?
say_en.note: It walks the refusal detection and architect gate.
